# Chapters 7 and 8: systems for level-builders

Logic is in `src/systems/`, numbers in `src/content/tuning.ts`, types in `src/core/types.ts` and `src/core/chapter.ts`. Tests: `tests/unit/c7c8-*.test.ts`. The world view (`src/systems/view/`) draws every system below; `hazardView.ts` is new. **No system saves an "already started" flag**: a boss, fight or puzzle started by a `script` trigger starts again after a load or a return to the bar.

Everything here that is new in `ChapterContext` is on `ctx` (`src/core/chapter.ts`).

## Heat (chapter 8)

A screen is sunny when `ScreenDef.sun` is true. Andrew is in the sun unless he stands on a shade tile (`~` in the grid art), in a shade area, or heat is off. In the sun: drain x`overhaul.sun.drainMultiplier` (2), beer x1.5, whiskey and tequila windows x1.5 (`meter.ts`, unchanged). Thermal masts see him only at Bit much or above *and* in the sun, so shade and night hide him.

```ts
// ScreenLayout
shadeAreas: [{ x, y, width, height }, ...],   // px: rock outcrops, the roadhouse awning
nightAmbient: { tint: 'navyDark', strength: 0.6, lights: [...] },  // optional; default is TUNING.overhaul.sunsetAmbient

// ctx
ctx.setShadeArea('truck', { x, y, width, height });  // a parked truck's shadow; null removes it; run-time only
ctx.setShadeArea('truck', null);
ctx.setHeatActive(false);   // heat off (saved flag sys.heatOff); emits heat:switched { active }
ctx.sunset();               // heat off + every screen takes its nightAmbient (saved flag sys.night)
ctx.heat();                 // { active, sunnyScreen, inSun }
ctx.heatActive(); ctx.isNight();
```
- The HUD sun mark already reads `meter.inSun` (`strip.ts`); `uiState.heat()` also gives `{ active, sunnyScreen, inSun }`.
- The time of day is **not** undone by a return to the bar. After a full load it comes back only if a save was written after `sunset()`, so call `sunset()` again from the script's fence trigger (it is a no-op when already night). Moving shade areas are run-time only: set them again in `onStart` and `onBarReturn`.
- Chapter provides: `ScreenDef.sun: true` on the three screens (or only the outdoors), `shadeAreas` for the outcrops and awning (the layout already has `PERIMETER_SHADE` and `FIGHT_TRUCK_SHADE`), the call to `sunset()` at beat 6.
- View: shade areas are drawn as a soft dark patch while heat is on. Needed art: none. Optional: a shade-patch frame.

## Perimeter hazards and the junction puzzle (chapter 8)

`StealthHazardDef`s already existed; this round adds the view and a builder from the layout's own data:

```ts
import { perimeterHazards, junctionLayoutFrom } from '../../systems/perimeter';

export const PERIMETER_STEALTH: StealthSectionDef = {
  id: 'c8.stealth.perimeter', ...,
  hazards: perimeterHazards({ lines: SENSOR_LINES, masts: THERMAL_MASTS, trucks: PATROL_TRUCKS }),
};
```
- Ground sensor: `TUNING.overhaul.perimeter.sensorRadiusPx`. Sees Andrew only while he moves at full speed (Shift sneaks: safe); standing still is safe. Ids: `c8.line<N>.s<i>` (`lineSensorId`).
- Thermal mast: `mastRangePx`, line of sight blocked by sight-blocking tiles. Ids `c8.mast<i>`.
- Patrol truck: `truckSpeed`, spotter cone `truckCone` (one cone: the truck's headlights are the spotter). It drives its route through the track; rock outcrops that block sight block the cone. Detection needs it fill for `stealth.detectionFillMs`.
- View (`hazardView.ts`): sensors are a small lamp (red live, white on alert, grey when switched off), masts an amber lamp, trucks use the existing `hazard.patrolTruck` sprite (`walk` animation, mirrored left) and the cone is already drawn.

### `c8.puzzle.junctions`

GF(2) flip-two: every box flips its two lines; the goal is `targetOff` lines off (2, 3, 4); lines 1 and 5 may be either. `minToggles(layout)` is 3, one per box, any order.

```ts
junctionPuzzles: [{
  sectionId: 'c8.puzzle.junctions',
  layout: junctionLayoutFrom({ lines: SENSOR_LINES, boxes: JUNCTION_BOXES, targetLines: CORRIDOR_LINES, stealthId: 'c8.stealth.perimeter' }),
}],
// examinables: one per box, id junctionExaminableId(box.id) = 'c8.junction.near' | 'c8.junction.middle' | 'c8.junction.far',
// at box.spot. E on it toggles the box. Give each its dialogue (`c8.junction.diagram`) as usual.
```
- Each press flips both lines, switches those lines' `groundSensor` hazards on or off (`StealthControl.setHazardEnabled`), emits `junctions:toggled { puzzleId, boxId, off }`, and saves which lines are off in flag `junctions.<id>` (restored on load). Solving completes the section (reward, `section:completed`).
- A stealth section that starts over (return to the bar, alarm) has its hazards rebuilt; the run re-applies the lines at once. A solved puzzle keeps the target lines off.
- `ctx.junctions(id)` gives the puzzle (`linesOff()`, `isLineOff`, `toggles`, `views()`); `completeNow()` switches the target lines off.
- `JunctionLayout` also accepts hand-made data: `{ lines: [{ id, sensorIds }], boxes: [{ id, examinableId, toggles: [a, b] }], stealthId, targetOff }`.
- View: the lamps go grey when a line is off. Needed from the chapter: the diagram on each box (dialogue + examinable).

## Fence fight headlights

```ts
fights: [{ sectionId: 'c8.fight.fence', ..., headlights: { position, facingDeg, cone: { range, angleDeg } } }]
```
While the fight is under way (and only then: nothing is saved), a dart (`frame 'dart'`, the agents' projectile) that is inside the cone flies `TUNING.overhaul.headlights.dartSpeedMultiplier` times faster (`Projectile.speedScale`). The view draws the parked truck sprite and a lit cone. `run.headlightsHere()` lists the active ones. The chapter still places the truck's shade (`ctx.setShadeArea`).

## Clerks (chapter 7)

`clerk` lines up: when two or more are alive, each stands on one bearing from Andrew (the nearest keeps its bearing; the next `overhaul.clerkLine.spacingPx` behind it, and so on), at the ranged preferred distance, and fires down the line. They fire as soon as they are in range; they move into the line between bursts. Nothing to do in the chapter: place them as `clerk`s. A Stumble lane (width 20) or the umbrella's two-enemy pierce along the line catches them (tested with `lineUpGoals`).

## Last Orders, tequila, inflatable alien, Barred

- Last Orders: key 4 at Fecked. Every living enemy and boss body on the current screen: ordinary enemies left at `leaveHealthFraction` (5%) and stunned `stunMs` (3 s); a boss body loses `bossFraction` (20%) of its max and is not stunned; it ignores Zorp's sign. Draws a ring (`FxEvent 'wipe'`).
- Tequila: `uiState`/HUD unchanged. Drops only from chapter 7.
- Inflatable alien: `ctx.gainWeapon('inflatableAlien')`; swing arc 160 degrees, damage 2, knockback 220.
- Barred: key 4 at Fecked, needs a target within `moveRange` (else `ui.move.noTarget`). The enemy is lifted to Andrew's hands and thrown out; everyone within `landingRadius` of where he comes down takes `landingDamage`. A boss takes `bossDamage`. `FxEvent 'throw'` (`from` = Andrew, `pos` = landing, `ttlMs` = `overhaul.throwOutFlightMs`) is drawn as a body in an arc plus a landing ring.

## `c7.puzzle.tells`

```ts
tellsPuzzles: [{
  sectionId: 'c7.puzzle.tells',
  accuseExaminableId: 'c7.till',        // optional: E here opens the accuse screen once every figure is examined
  layout: {
    figures: [{ id: 'a', examinableId: 'c7.fig.a' }, ... six, including 'gary'],
    aliens: ['b', 'd', 'gary'],          // fixed set
    promptTextId: 'c7.tells.prompt', rightTextId: 'c7.tells.right', wrongTextId: 'c7.tells.wrong',
  },
}],
```
- E on a figure's examinable examines it: the examinable's dialogue (the tells) plays as usual, the puzzle records it (`tells:examined`) and saves `tells.<id>` in the flags. Or call `ctx.examineFigure(id, figureId)`.
- The accuse screen opens with `ctx.openTells(id)` (false until all six are examined) or by `accuseExaminableId`.
- A wrong accusation costs nothing: no meter change, the screen stays open, `tells:accused { correct: false }`. The right three solve it (`completeNow()` examines everyone and solves it).

UI scene must call (on `uiState`, already added in `session.ts`; add them to `UiStateSource` in `src/ui/contract.ts` and the fake source):
- `activeTells(): TellsView | null` : `{ puzzleId, promptTextId, figures: [{ id, examined, labelTextId?, tellTextIds? }], pick: 3 }`; non-null while the screen is open.
- `submitTells(puzzleId, figureIds[3]): TellsTry` : `{ correct, textId, refused }`; show `textId`; `refused` = not three distinct examined figures.
- or one at a time: `selectTells(puzzleId, figureId): TellsTry | null` and `tellsSelection(): string[]` (the third tick accuses).
- `closeTells()` to step back.
Alternative with no new scene: an accuse prompt on each figure that calls `selectTells`.

## `c7.boss.mascots`

```ts
bosses: [{ bossId: 'c7.boss.mascots', screenId: 'c7.strip', trigger: { kind: 'script' }, entrance,
  bodies: [ { tag: 'zorp', position, spriteKey: 'boss.c7.boss.mascots.zorp' }, { tag: 'zap', ... }, { tag: 'zip', ... } ],
  mascots: { arena: px rect (30 x 14 tiles), tumbleLine: { from: ZIP_TUMBLE_LINE.from, to: ZIP_TUMBLE_LINE.to } },
}]
```
The director holds the three bodies still (`pinned`) and moves them; their own AI does nothing.
- Formation: Zorp stands `standOffPx` (120) from Andrew, toward the others; Zip and Zap `frontOffsetPx` behind him and `sideOffsetPx` to either side; the line follows Andrew. When Zorp falls the others step up to the stand-off.
- Zip: with a `tumbleLine` he stands on the line's row and, when Andrew is within `tumbleTriggerPx` (48) of the line and the attack is ready, the whole line lights for `zipTumble` telegraph, then he rolls to the line's `to` end (heavy hit if he touches Andrew), then lies on his back (`stun`) for `recoveryMs` (2 s, open to hits; the view draws him `down`), then walks back. With no `tumbleLine` he rolls at Andrew for the attack's distance.
- Zap: when ready and in range, three lines are marked for the telegraph, then three bolts leave together `fanSpreadDeg` apart (centre on Andrew); stand in a gap or step aside. Ordinary hit each.
- Zorp: `BossRunner.guard('zorp', 'front')`: hits from the front do nothing. A Stumble through him calls `onStumbled`: the sign is knocked away `signKnockedMs` (3 s; the Stumble's own hit lands), `mascots:changed signKnocked`, then `signBack`. Hits from the side or behind land.
- Speed: the boss phases `three`, `two`, `one` (tuning) multiply attack speed and formation speed as mascots fall. `mascots:changed fell { tag }` for each.
- End (all three down, or a Myko call): `mascots:changed applause` once, and `view().applauding` is true for `applauseMs`. **The chapter** plays the crowd (tourists clapping) and the tip from `onEnd`; the view only draws small clap marks along the arena's top edge.
- Reset: a return to the bar resets the encounter and the director.
- Art wanted (stand-ins in use): a sign sprite for Zorp up and knocked away (`prop.zorpSign.up`, `.dropped`, about 12 x 10); a clapping tourist animation for the crowd NPCs; a zip-on-back frame (the `down` frame is used).

## `c8.boss.pruitt2`

```ts
bosses: [{ bossId: 'c8.boss.pruitt2', screenId: 'c8.gate', trigger: { kind: 'script' }, entrance, callId: 'pruitt',
  bodies: [{ tag: 'pruitt', position }],
  pruitt2: {
    barrierLines: [{ id, from, to }, ...],           // the marked lines the arm can drop on (px)
    truckPath: { from, to, width },                  // the lit path (px; ends may be off the screen)
  },
}]
```
- Phase 1 (`gate`): the body keeps `darts` (burst 2). The director plays `flashbang` and `barrier`; they never overlap.
  - Flashbang: ground marker (`fx.groundMarker`, scaled) on Andrew's spot for the telegraph (1 s), a white burst, and if he is inside the radius `pruitt2.whiteoutMs` of white-out: `run.whiteoutAlpha()` and `uiState.whiteoutAlpha()` give 0..1 (the world view already draws it as a full-screen white rectangle). No meter hit.
  - Barrier: the nearest marked line is lit, then the arm drops: a heavy hit if he is within `barrierWidthPx` of the line. It stays down `barrierDownMs`, then lifts (`barrierLit`, `barrierDown`, `barrierUp`).
- Phase 2 (`truck`, 60%): every 12 s (the `truckPass` cooldown, measured start to start) the path is lit (`PROP.floorRail.lit` stamps) for 1.5 s, then the `hazard.patrolTruck` sprite drives it in `truckTravelMs`: a worst hit if it touches Andrew. `forcePhase('truck')` works for tests.
- End: at 40% health, or a Myko call (`completeNow`): `BossDef.letThrough` is set, so Pruitt is **not** knocked down: bodies freeze, every marker clears, `pruitt:changed letThrough` is emitted once, and the boss completes. **The chapter** plays the watch, the barrier raising and the lanyard from `bossHooks['c8.boss.pruitt2'].onEnd`.
- Events (`pruitt:changed`): `flashLit flash whiteout barrierLit barrierDown barrierUp truckLit truckPass letThrough`.

## Stealth feasibility

`tests/unit/stealthPlanner.ts` now plans over patrol trucks (their recorded positions and cones) and, with `heat: (p) => boolean`, over thermal masts (a route that is at Bit much in the sun). Ground sensors are not planned around: a sneaking route is always safe from them. To add the perimeter to `stealth-feasibility.test.ts`: give the case the section def with `hazards: perimeterHazards(...)` (see `c7c8-stealth.test.ts`, "has a route past the trucks ...", which already plans the chapter 8 perimeter over its own grid: a route exists).
